sn11.20:1.1: sāvatthiyaṁ → sāvatthiyaṁ viharati (bj) | jetavane → jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme (bj) | sutaṁ → sāvatthiyaṁ jetavane tatra -pe- etadavoca (bj: machasaṁ)

sn11.20:1.5: sahassayuttaṁ ājaññarathaṁ → sahassayuttam ajaññarathaṁ (pts) | bhadanta → S3 bhadanta. (pts note)
sn11.20:1.8: añjaliṁ katvā → pañjaliko (bj) | añjaliṁ katvā sudaṁ → pañjaliko sudam (pts)
sn11.20:1.9: gāthāya → gāthāhi (bj) | gāthāhi → gāthāya (bj: machasaṁ, syā, PTS)

(pts note)
sn11.20:3.2: vāsava ācāraṁ isinaṁ → vasava ācāram isīnaṁ (pts) | anāgārāna → B. anagārāna here and further on. (pts note)
sn11.20:3.4: tavāti → tavāti sakko (bj) | ti → S1-3 tavanti. (pts note)

sn11.20:6.1: sumantamantino → sumantamantīno (pts) | sumantamantīno → S1-3 sumanti-. (pts note)
sn11.20:6.4: ca → S3 mañcāca; C. puthumaccāhi (for macchi?). (pts note)
